verdict.rationale: Mollie is a payments platform; while it exposes APIs (Balances, Settlements, etc.) for retrieving transaction data, there is no evidence of a bulk 'export all my data in open formats and leave' capability, data portability tool, or account-closure data export feature. missing for 10: a documented full-account data export/portability feature, an open-format bulk export tool, and any account closure/data takeout process.
